usedFor: DitCal holds bookings and Asana holds projects, so “New Booking” in DitCal can start “Create Project” in Asana.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each booking gets its own Asana project with a name, notes and dates set up front.

watchOut: “Booking Cancelled” in DitCal can also run “Create Project”, so keep that trigger off to avoid projects for cancelled work.
